name: micro-fe-prototype
description: Two micro frontend integration strategies (shared React singleton vs independent React versions) running side by side

scripts.start: bun scripts/ports.mjs check all && bun run build && bun run serve
scripts.start:option1: bun scripts/ports.mjs check option1 && bun run build:option1 && bun run serve:option1
scripts.start:option2: bun scripts/ports.mjs check option2 && bun run build:option2 && bun run serve:option2
scripts.dev: bun scripts/ports.mjs check all && concurrently -k -n compare,o1-shell,o1-app1,o1-app2,o2-shell,o2-app1,o2-app2 -c magenta,blue,cyan,cyan,yellow,green,green "bun run --cwd compare dev" "bun run --cwd option1-shared/shell dev" "bun run --cwd option1-shared/app1 dev" "bun run --cwd option1-shared/app2 dev" "bun run --cwd option2-independent/shell dev" "bun run --cwd option2-independent/app1 dev" "bun run --cwd option2-independent/app2 dev"
scripts.dev:option1: bun scripts/ports.mjs check option1 && concurrently -k -n o1-shell,o1-app1,o1-app2 -c blue,cyan,cyan "bun run --cwd option1-shared/shell dev" "bun run --cwd option1-shared/app1 dev" "bun run --cwd option1-shared/app2 dev"
scripts.dev:option2: bun scripts/ports.mjs check option2 && concurrently -k -n o2-shell,o2-app1,o2-app2 -c yellow,green,green "bun run --cwd option2-independent/shell dev" "bun run --cwd option2-independent/app1 dev" "bun run --cwd option2-independent/app2 dev"
scripts.build: bun run build:option1 && bun run build:option2
scripts.serve: bun scripts/ports.mjs check all --built && concurrently -k -n compare,o1-shell,o1-app1,o1-app2,o2-shell,o2-app1,o2-app2 -c magenta,blue,cyan,cyan,yellow,green,green "bun run --cwd compare dev" "bun run --cwd option1-shared/shell preview" "bun run --cwd option1-shared/app1 preview" "bun run --cwd option1-shared/app2 preview" "bun run --cwd option2-independent/shell preview" "bun run --cwd option2-independent/app1 preview" "bun run --cwd option2-independent/app2 preview"
scripts.serve:option1: bun scripts/ports.mjs check option1 --built && concurrently -k -n o1-shell,o1-app1,o1-app2 -c blue,cyan,cyan "bun run --cwd option1-shared/shell preview" "bun run --cwd option1-shared/app1 preview" "bun run --cwd option1-shared/app2 preview"
scripts.serve:option2: bun scripts/ports.mjs check option2 --built && concurrently -k -n o2-shell,o2-app1,o2-app2 -c yellow,green,green "bun run --cwd option2-independent/shell preview" "bun run --cwd option2-independent/app1 preview" "bun run --cwd option2-independent/app2 preview"
